vendors.name: Judith L. Seltz Senior Wellness Center
vendors.description: Free food at Judith L. Seltz Senior Wellness Center (Serving Seniors). Schedule: Mon–Fri from 12 PM (lunch). Eligibility: Adults 60+ (no cost). Call (619) 235-6572 to confirm before you go — hours change and supplies can run out. Source: community research, Sep 2026.
vendors.address: 5257 Mt. Etna Dr, San Diego, CA 92117
